On the other hand fluorine is more electronegative than nitrogen, shared pair of electrons of N - F  bond spent more times with fluorine ( closer to fluorine ) giving less bond pair repulsion as compared to N - H bond. In trimethylamine, 'N' atom is sp3 -hybridized.

Due to the presence of lone pair in sp3 -hybrid orbital, the geometry of (CH3)3N becomes pyramidal around nitrogen.

In (SiH3)3N, the 'N' atom is sp2 -hybridized.

The orientation of three sp2 -hybrid orbitals is plane-triangular, therefore, the geometry around 'N' becomes plane-triangular. Here the lone pair of electrons is transferred to vacant d-orbitals to each of three silicon atoms forming pπ-dπ multiple bonds. Consequently, SiH33N has no donor properties. For example
(SiH3)3N+BF3→ No reaction.
